name: Korean Bossam (Slow-Roasted Pork with Lettuce Wraps)
ingredients_verbatim: 3.5-4 kg/7-8 lb pork butt/shoulder (bone in & skinless)
1/2 cup (110g) white sugar
1/2 cup (115g) kosher or cooking salt
Brown Sugar Crust: 1 tbsp kosher or cooking salt
Brown Sugar Crust: 7 tbsp brown sugar
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 2.5 cups scallions (thinly sliced)
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1/2 cup fresh ginger (peeled, finely grated)
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1/3 cup canola oil
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1.5 tsp light soy sauce
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1 tsp sherry vinegar
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1/2 tsp kosher or cooking salt
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 2 tbsp ssamjang
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 1 tbsp gochujang
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 5 tsp sherry vinegar
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 2 tbsp canola oil
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 1 tbsp water
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 1 tsp white sugar
40-50+ butter/bib lettuce leaves
3 cups cooked white rice (serving side - omit for low-carb)
500g/1lb kimchi
12+ raw oysters (optional - SEAFOOD, drop per no-seafood rule)
why: Verified published nutrition 626 cal / 67g protein / 18g carb per serving - clears the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb band with an exceptional protein-to-calorie ratio. Distinct dish: NO bossam anywhere in the 100+ pork catalog (which is otherwise carnitas/adobo/tinga rice bowls). Structurally low-carb served as lettuce wraps (rice side dropped); pork shoulder slow-roasted then blasted, scales cleanly as a big roast for 14 weigh-and-divide portions. Note: 626 is near the ceiling so our label-DB recompute could drift over 650 - trimming the sugar cure (mostly rendered/discarded) and the sugary crust brings it toward mid-band. Confidence HIGH on band-clearance from source, MODERATE on surviving our own gate at the ceiling.
